name: inspira-file-upload
blurb: File upload with animated file list and optional grid pattern background.
description: Drag-and-drop file uploader with animated file entries. Accepts children for background pattern (FileUploadGrid). Responds to drag, drop, click, and hover.
use_when: Design-forward file uploads with customizable background patterns.
avoid_when: Performance-critical contexts; animations may impact older devices.
a11y: Input hidden but clickable. Drop zone responds to drag/drop events.
